|strategy=Head of the Black Sun criminal organization, [[Prince Xizor]] is a member of the alien species known as Falleen. Xizor holds a secret hatred for [[Darth Vader]], who was responsible for killing his family. It is because of this that he constantly strives against [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] to become the Emperor's premier lieutenant.

When Xizor heard that [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] was searching for [[Luke Skywalker]], the crime lord decided he would find [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Skywalker]] first, and kill him to deny [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] his prize.<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/reflections2/dark/small/princexizor.html</ref>
